meta.name: character-design-sheet
meta.description: Character consistency across AI-generated images with reference sheets and LoRA techniques. Covers turnaround views, expression sheets, color palettes, and style consistency tricks. Use for: character design, game art, illustration, animation, comics, visual novels. Triggers: character design, character sheet, character consistency, character reference, turnaround sheet, expression sheet, character art, consistent character, character concept, reference sheet, character creation, oc design, character bible

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 保持角色形象在AI生成图片中始终一致
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要让AI生成的角色在不同画面中长相统一
copy.tagline_en: Keep character appearance consistent across AI-generated images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need consistent character visuals across AI-generated images

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能指导你通过命令行生成角色设计图，包括多角度转面、表情集、配色方案等，并保持角色在不同图片中的一致性。
howto.when: 当你提到“角色设计”、“角色一致性”、“转面图”、“表情集”等关键词，或要求为游戏、动画等创建统一角色形象时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一个角色的正面、侧面和背面三视图。
say.note: Claude 会给出生成各视图的命令。

say.text: 如何保持同一个角色在多张图片中长相一致？
say.note: Claude 会介绍描述锚点、LoRA 等方法。

say.text: 为我的角色设计一个包含6种表情的表情集。
say.note: Claude 会提供生成不同表情的命令。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can guide you to generate character design images via command line, including turnaround views, expression sheets, color palettes, etc., and maintain character consistency across multiple images.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "character design", "character consistency", "turnaround sheet", "expression sheet", or ask to create a consistent character for games, animation, etc.

say_en.text: Generate front, side, and back views of a character.
say_en.note: Claude will provide commands for each view.

say_en.text: How to keep the same character consistent across images?
say_en.note: Claude will explain description anchor, LoRA, etc.

say_en.text: Create an expression sheet with 6 emotions for my character.
say_en.note: Claude will give commands for different expressions.
